support_claim: Commercial notes establish that Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal entity via unchanged HRB 88421 and that CRM retains the old English-facing name, which OAK-77 displays, while billing uses the post-rebrand registry name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.

steps.fact: CRM record OAK-77 displays the counterparty name 'Oakfield Logistics'.
The legal entity formerly registered as Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH while Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
Unchanged HRB 88421 licenses that Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH denote the same legal entity.
Commercial notes state that CRM still shows the old English-facing name for that rebranded entity.

The packet's CRM observation for candidate left crm:OAK-77 displays 'Oakfield Logistics', the old English-facing CRM name described in commercial notes for the entity that rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Handelsregister HRB 88421 registers Oakfield Logistik GmbH as the current legal name.
Billing invoices bill the counterparty as Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
